composition: Ruined forum and Temple of Jupiter in afternoon light · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks north along the ruined open square of the Forum of Pompeii in the afternoon. The paving is an open field of stone with low foundation stubs. At the far end the Temple of Jupiter is a high podium with one standing column and broken column stumps, no roof and no full colonnade, and only fragmentary colonnade stubs remain along the east side. Vesuvius sits on the horizon. The modelled scenario is 30 September 2026 at 14:25 Europe/Rome: clear, 26.7°C, cloud cover about 1 percent, strong afternoon sun.
